mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS id, p.user_id AS userId, p.name AS name, pp.user_id AS participantUserId, pp.role AS participantRole, pp.permission_level AS permissionLevel FROM project p LEFT JOIN project_participants pp ON p.id = pp.project_id WHERE pp.user_id = #{userId} OR p.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id AS id, name AS name, user_id AS userId, create_at AS createAt FROM project WHERE id = #{projectId}
SELECT id AS id, project_id AS projectId, user_id AS userId, name AS name, role AS role, permission_level AS permissionLevel FROM project_participants WHERE project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT id AS id, project_id AS projectId, user_id AS userId, name AS name, role AS role, permission_level AS permissionLevel FROM project_participants WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id AS id, project_id AS projectId, parent_id AS parentId, type AS type, name AS name, depth AS depth, item_order AS itemOrder, create_at AS createAt FROM project_items WHERE id = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (name, create_at, user_id) VALUES (#{name}, NOW(), #{userId})
INSERT INTO project_items ( project_id, parent_id, type, name, depth, create_at, item_order ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{parentId}, #{type}, #{name}, #{depth}, NOW(), #{itemOrder} )
INSERT INTO project_participants ( project_id, user_id, name, role, permission_level ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{role}, #{permissionLevel} )
